title: Jazzy Aerated Moroccan Mushrooms Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic Moroccan dish featuring wild mushrooms and a touch of char-grilled spices. Perfect for adventurous palates and cozy evenings.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium-low heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the wild mushrooms, cumin, coriander, paprika, kosher salt, and black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the lemon juice and cook, stirring to combine, for 1 minute.
Add the grilled chicken stock and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and braise the mixture, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender and the liquid has thickened slightly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over couscous for a filling meal.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
If desired, add some grilled chicken or lamb to the tagine for added protein and flavor.
Adjust the seasoning as needed before serving the tagine.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve hot, making sure to get a little bit of the crispy crust on each bite.
Garnish the tagine with some toasted almonds or pine nuts for added crunch and texture.
